name: mcp-sec-cli
description: Canary-proof security checks for MCP servers -- verifies real behavior instead of pattern-matching code.

scripts.sandbox:build: cd sandbox && docker compose -f compose.airgapped.yml build && docker compose -f compose.canary-net.yml build
scripts.sandbox:clean: cd sandbox && docker compose -f compose.airgapped.yml down --remove-orphans && docker compose -f compose.canary-net.yml down --remove-orphans
